title: tx_queue_stats_get reads stats without lock despite header claiming thread-safety
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 424

Header line 207-208 states 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation at line 424 reads queue->stats without holding the lock. The stats struct is 24 bytes which cannot be atomically read, causing potential torn reads. The implementation comment acknowledges this is acceptable for diagnostics. Fix: either add lock_queue/unlock_queue around the read, or update header documentation to match implementation.
